arabic text: PEHLU BHI SHIKASTA HAY TURBAT BHI SHIKASTA HAY.
english translation text: HER RIBS ARE BROKEN, HER GRAVE IS DESTROYED TOO

arabic text: KYA HAAL YEH UMMAT NAY. ZAHRA KA BANAAYA HAY
english translation text: WHAT HAVE THE FOLLOWERS OF THE PROPHET DONE TO ZAHRA?

arabic text: KHATOON KOYI GHUM SAY, YUN CHURR NAYHI DEKHI\nAISI KOYI DUNIYA MAY, MASTOOR NAYHI DEKHI
english translation text: WE HAVEN’T SEEN A LADY INFLICTED WITH SO MUCH TRAGEDY. HISTORY HAS NEVER WITNESSED SUCH A WOMAN…

arabic text: ATHAARA BARAS MAY HI, LAGTI JO ZAEEFA HAY
english translation text: WHO LOOKS OLD DESPITE BEING ONLY EIGHTEEN YEARS OLD

arabic text: DARBAAR MAY ZAALIM NAY, KI AISI PAZEERAYI\nKIS TARHA SAY TU BIBI, PHIR LAUT KAY GHAAR AAYI
english translation text: WHAT KIND OF A WELCOME DID YOU RECEIVE IN THE COURT? IN WHAT MANNER DID YOU RETURN HOME, O BIBI?

arabic text: BAALON KI SAFAYDI NAY, SAB HAAL SUNAAYA HAY
english translation text: THE WHITENESS OF YOUR HAIR EXPLAINS THE ENTIRE STORY

arabic text: .TU ROTI RAHI GHAR MAY, HAIDER SAY BHI CHUP CHUP KAY\nISMAT KI TARHA DUKH BHI, PARDAY MAY RAHAY TERAY
english translation text: AT HOME, YOU WOULD CRY, HIDING YOUR PAIN FROM IMAM ALI. JUST LIKE YOUR CHASTITY, EVEN YOUR PAINS REMAINED VEILED

arabic text: KUCH DARD TERAY BIBI, BUS JAANTI FIZZA HAY…..
english translation text: SOME OF YOUR PAINS O BIBI, ARE KNOWN ONLY TO BIBI FIZZA

arabic text: DO AISAY JANAAZAY HAY, TAARIKH MAY JO UTHAY\nBUS GHAAR KAY HI LOGO NAY, DONO KO DIYE KAANDAY
english translation text: IN HISTORY, THERE WERE TWO SUCH FUNERALS…\nTHAT HAD ONLY THE MEMBERS OF THE HOUSEHOLD PRESENT TO CARRY THE BODY

arabic text: EK FATIMA ZAHRA HAY, EK BAALI SAKINA HAY…..
english translation text: ONE IS FATIMA ZAHRA AND THE OTHER IS LITTLE SAKINA

arabic text: MARHAM TERAY ZAKHMON KA, BIBI NA MILA AB TAK\nAULAAD-E- UMAYYA KI, BAAQI HAY JAFAA AB TAK
english translation text: TILL THIS DAY, THERE IS NO CURE TO THE PAIN YOU SUFFERED. THE INFLICTIONS OF BANI UMMAYYA CONTINUE TILL THIS DAY

arabic text: RONAY PEH BHI PEHRA TAH, TURBAT PEH BHI PEHRA HAY
english translation text: YOU WERE NOT ALLOWED TO CRY AND WE ARE NOT ALLOWED TO VISIT YOUR GRAVE

arabic text: MISMAAR TERA ROZA, UMMAT NAY KIYA JAB SAY\nBABA TERA REHTA HAY, TURBAT PEH TERI TAB SAY
english translation text: SINCE THE UMMAH DESTROYED YOUR GRAVE. YOUR FATHER (SAW) STAYS AT YOUR GRAVE

arabic text: KAB GHUMBAD-E- KHIZRA MAY, BABA TERA REHTA HAY
english translation text: WHEN DOES YOUR FATHER (SAW) REST UNDER THE GREEN DOME NOW?
